meta.title: Bridge MA: next steps for food, housing, and utility help
meta.description: A fictional demo that turns a hard moment into sourced next steps for SNAP, RAFT, and utility shutoff protection in Massachusetts.

landing.purpose: Bridge MA turns a hard moment into clear, sourced next steps for SNAP, RAFT, and utility shutoff protection in Massachusetts.
landing.disclosureTitle: This is a demo with fictional data
landing.disclosureBody: It uses made-up people and documents. It is not a government website. It does not decide who can get benefits, give legal advice, or send applications for you.

story.title: Tell your story
story.notBuilt: This step is not built yet.

intake.title: Tell Bridge what is happening
intake.intro: Use your own words. Bridge listens for needs across food, housing, and utilities, then asks only the questions that matter.
intake.welcome: Hi, I’m Bridge. Tell me what changed and what feels most urgent. You do not need to know which agency or program to ask for.
intake.fictionalNotice: Use fictional information in this demo. Do not enter names, exact addresses, Social Security numbers, account numbers, or medical records.
intake.placeholder: Example: I live in Boston, lost my job, and I am worried about rent…
intake.voiceUnavailable: Voice input is not available in this browser. You can type your answer instead.
intake.assistantError: Bridge could not process that message. Your text was not lost; please try again.
intake.noFacts: Share a little about your situation and the details Bridge hears will appear here.
intake.understoodNote: Nothing here is an eligibility decision. You will check every detail before Bridge builds a plan.
intake.demoStory: I am a single parent living in Boston with my child. I recently lost my job, rent my home, and received a Notice to Quit. The utility account is in my name, but I do not know whether I received a formal shutoff notice. I prefer Spanish.
intake.requiredNote: No field is required. Anything left blank is treated as “unknown.”

confirm.title: Check what Bridge understood
confirm.intro: Correct anything that is wrong. “I don’t know” is a valid answer, and Bridge will keep that uncertainty visible.
confirm.confirmAll: Everything looks right — build my plan
confirm.editHint: Need to fix something? Edit only that line, then build your plan.
confirm.unconfirmedNotice: Bridge found {count} detail(s) for you to review below.
confirm.allConfirmedNotice: All facts confirmed. You can continue to your next steps.
confirm.areaContextNote: Neighborhood is area context only. It never affects whether a program matches.
confirm.noSession: There is nothing to show yet. Your answers are kept only during this visit and were cleared.

errors.number_required: Please enter a whole number, or choose “I don’t know.”
errors.number_not_whole: Please enter a whole number with no decimal point.
errors.number_out_of_range: Please enter a number within the allowed range.
errors.choice_invalid: Please choose one of the listed options.
errors.boolean_invalid: Please choose Yes, No, or “I don’t know.”

journey.startOver: Go to step 1: Tell your story

actions.documentsIntro: Bridge keeps one reusable checklist so you do not have to reconstruct the same story for every agency.

documents.noUpload: This app does not upload, scan, or store documents.

help.noneCantTell: No program is currently marked "can't tell yet".
help.humanHelpIntro: Ask for one of these by name. This demo does not list phone numbers or addresses.
help.legalAidNotice: You said you got a Notice to Quit. Ask legal aid any questions about the notice.

handoff.intro: This summary is in English and Spanish. You can bring it to a caseworker or a legal aid office.
handoff.errorBackToConfirm: Go back and check your answers

evidence.E-NTQ: Copy of the Notice to Quit

nextStep.snap: Start a SNAP application through DTA Connect or call DTA. You may begin with your name, address (if any), and signature; DTA will tell you which verifications it still needs.
nextStep.raft: Start in the Massachusetts Housing Help Hub. Tell your landlord or property manager they must complete their part, and ask legal aid about the Notice to Quit.
nextStep.utility: Call your utility company first and ask for shutoff protection. If service is not protected or restored after that call, contact the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities.
